title: OpenAI’s Sora was the creepiest app on your phone -- now it's shutting down | TechCrunch
summary: OpenAI discontinued Sora, an AI-driven social app that struggled with sustained interest and faced legal issues due to deepfake content, despite initial hype and high download numbers.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights issues such as the app's inability to maintain user interest, legal challenges due to deepfakes, and the eventual collapse of a significant licensing deal, all of which contribute to a negative market impact.
